{{Top|leg}}
The '''Daughters of the Ffib''' were an autocratic, exclusively [[Gender/Legends|female]] religious order, active during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
A sect of the [[Order of the Ffib]] based on [[Lorahns/Legends|Lorahns]], they established a mission on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], in an attempt to bring the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] into the order.

When [[Reess Kairn]] destroyed the [[Great Temple (Lorahns)|Great Temple]], the Daughters of the Ffib employed [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to hunt down Kairn and eliminate him.
